title: Damage Charts
description:
Damage analytics and an incoming-damage forecast for Slay the Spire 2.

- Incoming forecast, docked beside your character: the HP you're about to lose this turn and what you'll be left at (a range when uncertain). Counts enemy intents, damage over time, self-damage cards, Block, Osty and end-of-turn Block (Plating, Orichalcum, Cloak Clasp), and ignores enemies that will die to Poison first. Reads Safe when nothing can hurt you; hover it for the per-round history and itemized sources.
- Combat stats (default C): damage dealt and taken by source, a per-round chart, potions used and a scrollable combat log.
- End-of-combat summary beside the rewards list, and a run recap out of combat.
- Uses the game's own fonts, icons and frames; optional big-moment effects with the game's own VFX.

Single-player and multiplayer. Standalone, depends on no other mod. By-name attribution for damage-over-time, relic, orb and potion hits is opt-in via the source_hooks config.
changeNote: Incoming-damage forecast docked beside your character; potions in the combat summary; the game's own fonts, icons and frames; trackpad scrolling; summary only beside the rewards list; layout fixes.
